title: Five Nights at Freddy's
notes: Plays. The menu and a night of gameplay run at a steady 60 fps on DXVK, GPU about 0.5 ms, on an Apple M1 Pro (macOS 26.6.2, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r2). It is a Clickteam Fusion Direct3D 9 game, so DXVK (the automatic and DXVK modes both route Direct3D 9 through it) is the right mode; Wine's own Direct3D also runs but is the slow path. A save is written under the environment, so Continue works on the next launch. On a display that is not 16:10 apply the recipe: it sets EmulateModeset for the game so Wine emulates the 1280x800 mode the game asks for and the picture fills the screen instead of landing off centre (highball#72).

verified.fps: 60 at the menu and through a night on DXVK (Metal HUD). Re-read 2026-09-09 on engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r2: 59.9 at the menu, GPU 0.5 ms, at both 1728x1117 and 1280x800. A first reading of 51.5 was a startup transient and does not stand.

knownIssues.symptom: Without the recipe, on a display whose logical resolution is not 16:10: the picture sits down and to the right with black bars along the top and left, and is clipped at the right and bottom edges.
knownIssues.cause: The game asks Wine for a 1280x800 fullscreen mode; Wine's Mac driver reports success but leaves the display as it is (measured 2026-09-07), so the game positions itself for a resolution it never got.
knownIssues.fix: The recipe (2026-09-11): one registry value, EmulateModeset=y for the game's executable, makes Wine emulate the mode change and scale the fullscreen window to the real screen. Verified by eye at 1728x1117: fills the screen, centred. No engine change, works on the default engine.
